description: The University of Glasgow has been changing the world since 1451. It is one of the top 100 universities in the world and one of the largest research bases in the UK. Alumni include seven Nobel Prize winners, a Prime Minister and Scotland’s First Minister, while Honorary Graduate Albert Einstein gave a lecture on the theory of relativity back in 1933. It is ranked #73 in QS Global World Rankings 2022. Timestamps Updated
